# FastVideo MLX runtime — fully-resolved, hash-pinned lock for
# ~/.portos/fastvideo/.venv on Apple Silicon (arm64 macOS). Do not edit by hand.
#
# scripts/setup-image-video.sh (INSTALL_FASTVIDEO=1) installs this with
# `uv pip sync --require-hashes --only-binary :all: --python "${FASTVIDEO_PY}"`, followed by
# `uv pip install --no-deps --no-build-isolation -e "${FASTVIDEO_DIR}"`, so every transitive package is
# version- and hash-pinned and a tampered or substituted distribution fails the install.
# The lock is universal across CPython 3.11+ (per-Python versions carry
# environment markers; 3.10 is excluded because filelock's security fix needs 3.11),
# restricted to arm64 macOS wheels.
#
# Regenerate after editing requirements-fastvideo-mlx.txt, from the repo root,
# with a cooldown so brand-new releases are not adopted the day they publish.
# Set CUTOFF to a UTC date at least seven days before each regeneration.
# Last regenerated with uv 0.13.7 and CUTOFF=2026-11-05T00:00:00Z:
#   LOCK="$PWD/scripts/requirements-fastvideo-mlx.lock.txt"; TMP="$(mktemp -d)"
#   cp scripts/requirements-fastvideo-mlx.txt "$LOCK" "$TMP/"
#   printf '[project]\nname = "fastvideo-lock"\nversion = "0"\n[tool.uv]\nenvironments = ["sys_platform == '"'"'darwin'"'"' and platform_machine == '"'"'arm64'"'"'"]\n' > "$TMP/pyproject.toml"
#   (cd "$TMP" && uv pip compile requirements-fastvideo-mlx.txt --universal --python-version 3.11 \
#     --generate-hashes --only-binary :all: --no-header --annotation-style line \
#     --exclude-newer "$CUTOFF" -o requirements-fastvideo-mlx.lock.txt)
#   cp "$TMP/requirements-fastvideo-mlx.lock.txt" "$LOCK"
# then check the result against OSV (including MAL- malicious-package records).
# OSV querybatch (including MAL records), 2026-11-12: all 88 distributions, 0 matches.
